text: Metropolitan Shio Mujiri - If we turn to the Lord for help, if our desire is real and strong, He will surely come with His grace, rectify us, and cleanse us.

The Lord expects us to compel our wounded souls, burdened by our sins, to turn for salvation and mercy. Only God can achieve our correction and inner change. We are unable to do this by our own strength—the Locum Tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio (Mujiri) of Senaki and Chkhorotsqu, stated this during his sermon at the Holy Trinity Cathedral, where the rite of the Taking Down from the Cross was performed a short while ago.
According to Metropolitan Shio, "if our desire is real, strong, and serious, the Lord will certainly come with His grace, correct us, and cleanse us."

“Through the glorious and ancient divine service of our church, which was composed by the great Holy Fathers, renowned hymnographers, the finest poets, thinkers, and wise men, we have the opportunity not only to learn from the Gospel about the events related to the Lord Jesus Christ, but through the divine service to become participants in these events. Therefore, today we have brought forth the Holy Epitaphios, and we are all participants in this event.”

Those gathered here, we who are gathered, are not those who a short while ago were shouting – crucify Him, crucify Him, but rather those who say to the Lord – forgive us, O Lord. We are taught by the Church, we know the teaching of the Church, that through our sins we crucify the Lord again and again; He came to earth, became incarnate, suffered, and died in order to liberate us from the captivity of sins, from the burden of sins.

Who was the first person whom the Lord freed from this burden? – One of the crucified robbers, the wise thief, who so deeply felt the sufferings of the innocent Savior that he confessed his sins and turned to the Savior from the cross with repentance. This is exactly what the Lord expects from us: that we compel our wounded souls, burdened by our sins, to turn to God for salvation and mercy.

Many of us, and some even for years, try independently to rectify something in our souls, in our lives without God, by our own strength. This is a futile attempt. It is merely an arrogant, foolish attempt, for only God can rectify us and bring about inner change. We are unable to do this by our own strength. We may slightly change our behavior externally, but it is unattainable for us to change internally, as the Lord says: "Without me, you can do nothing."

Dear brothers and sisters, the Lord desires our correction and purification. I remind you, once a sick man came to Him and addressed Him: "Lord, if You will, You can cleanse me." What did the Lord reply? – "I will; be cleansed." The Lord desires this. The will of man and God coincided, and that person was healed.

“So, the Lord desires our correction and purification even more than we do. If our desire is real, strong, and serious, and we turn to the Lord for help, He will surely come with His grace, correct us, and purify us. May God bless you and strengthen you. Let us pray to the Lord to give us strength and help, so that we may walk the path of truth and light, and together with Christ, amen,” stated Metropolitan Shio.
